meta.title: Privacy policy — Helpox
meta.description: What data Helpox collects, why, and how to export or delete it.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: [Company name] ("Helpox", "we") operates this service. Contact: [contact email]. [Business ID / registration number].

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Your email address and authentication session, from when you sign in.
Your credit balance and purchase history, from when you buy or use credits.
Nothing beyond what the service needs to work: no tracking cookies, no ad pixels, no Google Analytics.

sections.heading: Why we process it
body: To run your account, keep your credit balance accurate, and process your payments.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: Supabase — hosts our database and handles sign-in.
Vercel — hosts the application.
Polar — processes payments as our merchant of record; they handle VAT and sales tax.
Plausible — cookieless, aggregate website analytics. No personal data, no cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Until you delete your account. Deleting your account permanently and immediately removes your profile and credit history — see your account page.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Export all your data as a JSON file, or delete your account entirely, any time, from your account page. No request or waiting period needed.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We set no non-essential cookies — only what's strictly needed to keep you signed in.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions about this policy: [contact email].
